objective: Test all nine main partitions from the no-proximity schedule and compare each literal result set with the accepted ten-wildcard population candidate.

current_compound_blocks.G_structure: G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation OR (G_product AND M_B)

wildcard_candidate.prior_basis: Pilot 002 accepted this exact candidate for A1
wildcard_candidate.acceptance_rule: Adopt the candidate in a partition only if its strict complete result contains every literal stable ID. Inspect every wildcard-only record before accepting a broader set.
wildcard_candidate.preference_rule: Prefer the shorter wildcard rendering after acceptance.

acceptance_checks: All 18 events complete strict two-pass ordered WOS-ID and total reconciliation.
Every event has exact query, Core Collection, all-edition, oldest-sort, page-size, and native RIS evidence.
Every event saves a configured-search PNG and first-results PNG beside its JSON.
No query contains NEAR, SAME, another proximity operator, or pair expansion.
Each wildcard partition retains every literal WOS ID.
Every wildcard-only record receives a population-meaning review before acceptance.
